## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes
- [ ] `claude plugin validate . --strict` passes (if you have Claude Code)
- [ ] A line under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] For a change to `SKILL.md` or a reference file: eval results with and without the change (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No new outward-facing action without a stop-and-ask checkpoint
